the identification of common genes which respond in Arabidopsis seedlings exposed to P. inidica under Pi limitation, inactivation of WRKY6 and inactivation of WRXY18.
understanding the molecular mechanisms of root development under phosphate limitation and the role of WRKY6 in this process.
the identification of genes involved in root development and growth and the elucidation of their regulation.

P. indica stimulates root growth in wrky6 mutants under phosphate limitation by activating genes involved in hormone biosynthesis, transport, meristematic activity and cell proliferation.
